caption: The drawing depicts a single ice skate with a light gray sole and metal blade. The skate has a burgundy or deep red leather strap across the top, which is attached at two points on either side of the foot. From the strap, a pink ribbon is tied and trails loosely off to the left. The skate is viewed from an angle, with the toe oriented slightly forward and to the left. The blade is curved and metallic, catching some light, and the skate sits within a rectangular boundary lightly outlined in pencil. The background is an off-white or cream color, and there are no other objects in the composition.
title: Patten
